# Jitter RNG health test vector: repetition count test (RCT), intermittent and permanent.
#
# The deltas rise by a constant amount, so their second derivative is constant
# and their third is zero - which is the stuck condition. No delta ever
# repeats, so neither the lag predictor nor the adaptive proportion test has
# anything to latch onto and the RCT is the only test that fires.
#
# 200 measurements: past the RCT cutoff of 30*osr = 90 at osr 3 and past the permanent cutoff of 60*osr = 180.
#
# One decimal time stamp per line. Replay with:
#   tests/health/health --replay <this file>
